value: DXIL intrinsic overload must be valid
note: The reported symptom verbatim: the DXIL validator rejects the module DXC produced, with 'DXIL intrinsic overload must be valid'. Chosen as a POSITIVE text predicate over the validator's own wording, which is stable across the 2019 report ('at 0x280ab609bc0 inside block #0 of function ps_main DXIL intrinsic overload must be valid') and current formatting ('error: DXIL intrinsic overload must be valid.' plus a note naming the call). Deliberately NOT internal_failure and NOT nonzero_exit: a DXIL validation failure is a diagnosed error that exits E_FAIL (0x80004005) exactly like a syntax error, so internal_failure would invent a crash nobody reported and nonzero_exit would also fire on a front-end rejection of the source -- which is a live hazard here, because the default -HV has changed since 2019 and a newer default rejects element-wise ?: on a bool3 condition before codegen ever runs. Positive-text also avoids the absence-predicate trap: a release that cannot parse the repro emits no match and is scored no-repro, which is correct-by-construction only for a positive predicate. Control: control-named-temp.hlsl, the reporter's own '// Works' variant from the same attachment, must NOT match.
